description: fib (Fast In Balance) WebSocket echo through its websocket package: the RFC 6455 handshake and frame parser run as a connection handler on fib's edge-triggered epoll event loops, one per CPU through IOPollers, each accepting its own connections on an SO_REUSEPORT socket of its own through ReusePort, so each message is parsed from the buffer its loop read into and echoed with WriteMessage on that loop, with no goroutine per connection. Default configuration otherwise.
